name: child-boy
desc: FRAMING: close half-body portrait cropped at the waist, head and shoulders filling most of the frame — not a full-length figure. A village boy of about ten with a distracted neutral expression, already looking at something else: a scruff of copper-brown hair, ears that stick out, a scab on his chin, cheeks red from running. He wears a too-big olive-green tunic belted with cord over patched grey breeches, one shoulder-seam gone at the stitch, and a river-smoothed pebble held in one fist. Restless, entirely unsupervised.
sheetHint: scruffy copper-brown hair, sticking-out ears, scab on chin, too-big olive-green tunic belted with cord, patched grey breeches, pebble in fist
_note: ARCHETYPE bust, not a person. Background villagers in both towns map to it by dialogue.json speaker portrait; the same face may stand in several streets, exactly the way the four rigged GLBs are reused as bodies. Nobody wearing it has a name in the story bible.
